CustomField.description: Used for sender merge field in Reg B or Notice of Incomplete Application email for QB emails.
CustomField.formula: LEFT($Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) - 1) & ", " & MID($Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) + 2, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) + 1) - FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) - 2) & BR() & MID($Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) + 1) + 2, LEN($Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) - FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c, FIND(",", $Setup.Welcome_Email_Variables_QB__c.QB_Address__c) + 1) - 1)
CustomField.label: QB Brand Address
